headline: Plenković: Projects worth €5.5 billion contracted for Slavonia, Baranja and Srijem
summary: Prime Minister Plenković said projects worth €5.5 billion have been contracted for the Slavonia, Baranja and Srijem region. He expects this year's economic growth to reach 2.3 or 2.4 percent.
why: Croatia's economy relies on EU-funded public investment and tourism, and large infrastructure contracts shape construction activity and growth forecasts.
